topics.description: Multiple fraud schemes have been uncovered in Minnesota, including the $250M Feeding Our Future scandal and a $21M Medicaid fraud scheme.
topics.reason: Large amounts of money involved and multiple individuals and organizations implicated

topics.description: US Representative Ilhan Omar has been linked to the $250M Minnesota fraud scheme, with allegations that she knew about the scheme.
topics.reason: High-profile individual involved and potential connection to large-scale fraud
